Unit 10 — Jam Season

Two signature jams teach shipping under deadline: the January 3-Button Jam (at most three inputs, closing Semester 1 on Jan 21) and the Spring Card Game Jam (where GameManager lists, Shuffle(), and AI_Turn() prepare directly for the Create PT).

Concepts this unit owns

Jams are process tests: scope, freeze, playtest ritual, and one-fix discipline — and the card jam's lists, procedures, and algorithms ARE the Create PT's requirements, pre-built. CED: AAP-1/2/3, DAT-1, CRD-2.
